overall_summary: Data shows clear audience preference for husband-wife relationship dynamics (over 1,600+ views) compared to generic sad poetry or family tropes, proving that deep, relatable domestic emotional conflicts drive the highest engagement.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya?' (1,770 views) and 'पत्नी की ये बात हर पति को समझनी चाहिए' (1,679 views) massively outperformed all other topics.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on marital and long-term relationship emotional realities.

winning_patterns.evidence: Titles framing a relatable psychological question about love or regret (e.g., 'Har Baar Sorry Bolne Wala Galat Nahi Hota', 392 views) hold attention better than abstract shayari.
winning_patterns.action: Use conversational, direct-address questions about everyday relationship struggles.

weak_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'जिस दिन सच लिखूंगा… रिश्तों को षड्यंत्र लिखूंगा' received only 21 views, showing low initial click-through and hook retention.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid overly dramatic, poetic phrasing in favor of grounded, real-life situational observations.

weak_patterns.evidence: General family videos outside of core marital dynamics showed inconsistent or low numbers (e.g., sister emotional video at 19 views).
weak_patterns.action: Keep family content strictly tied to partner dynamics or universal silent sacrifices.
